cad.title: CAD Design
cad.subtitle: Accurate 3D and 2D drawings tailored to your project.
cad.intro: Using modern CAD software (Onshape), I deliver professional 3D models and 2D working drawings for mechanical and electrical installations. Every design is fully custom-made and aligned with your specifications and standards.
cad.feature1Text: Detailed 3D models of components, assemblies, and complete installations — clear and easy to verify.
cad.feature2Text: Production and revision drawings according to technical standards, with dimensions, parts lists, and tolerances.
cad.feature3Text: As an Onshape Certified Professional, I work with leading cloud-CAD software for efficient collaboration and version control.
cad.ctaText: Get in touch for a no-obligation conversation about your project.

visualization.title: 3D Visualisation
visualization.subtitle: Technical drawings transformed into compelling visual presentations.
visualization.intro: With 3D visualizations, I bring your technical designs to life. Whether for a client presentation, promotional material, or a clear explanation of a complex system — good visualization makes the difference.
visualization.feature1Text: Photo-realistic renders and animations that present your product or installation professionally.
visualization.feature2Text: Visualizations suitable for websites, brochures, videos, and social media — technically accurate and visually compelling.
visualization.feature3Text: Cross-sections, exploded views, and layered presentations that explain complex systems simply.
visualization.ctaText: Get in touch for a no-obligation conversation about your project.

integration.title: System Integration
integration.subtitle: Multiple disciplines brought together into one seamless whole.
integration.intro: System integration is connecting separate technical systems into one functioning whole. I coordinate and integrate mechanical, electrical, and software-driven systems — from PLC programming to show control and audiovisual installations.
integration.feature1Text: Integration of mechanics, electrical engineering, PLC programming, audio/video, and animatronics into one system.
integration.feature2Text: Timeline-driven systems for interactive attractions, theatre technology, and special effects installations.
integration.feature3Text: Technical alignment between disciplines, suppliers, and clients for a flawless end result.
integration.ctaText: Get in touch for a no-obligation conversation about your integration challenge.

projects.intro: From structural drawings to chassis designs, every project is tailored to the specific requirements.

plantMachineFrames.title: Various Frames for Plant Machines
plantMachineFrames.description: Design and detailing of various frames for use in plant machines. With or without specific customer requirements, such as steered rear wheels.

hekwerkCarrousel.title: Fencing for Carousel
hekwerkCarrousel.description: Structural drawings for fencing around a carousel. Including dimensions and fabrication details.

chassisStacaravan.title: Chassis for Static Caravan / Tiny House
chassisStacaravan.description: Chassis design for a static caravan and tiny house. Drawn for a client in various size versions: 5.5mx2.7m, 11mx2.7m and an XL version 12.4mx3.8m. All three sizes also in a splittable variant for efficient transport of multiple chassis at once on a low-loader.

bootLader.title: Boat Loader
bootLader.description: Design and detailing of a boat loader. From concept to production-ready drawings.

opklapbareTrap.title: Folding Staircase
opklapbareTrap.description: Fold-out and extendable staircase, custom-made for a mirror hatch on a sailing yacht with two different end positions.
